ops.statement: When a handoff pastes verbatim SKILL.md prose (a delegated body, a relocated doctrine block), dry-run that text against the residual-guard grep BEFORE dispatch — the retired-signature list lives in tests/test_install_constellation.py::test_relocated_doctrine_leaves_no_residual_in_carrier_skill_md. A load-bearing verbatim body that re-pastes single-sourced doctrine trips the no-residual guard and costs a rework round-trip. The fix is always pointer-not-paste (hyphenated slug + `see references/global-*.md`), never a test carve-out — a carve-out would legitimize the very residual the single-sourcing work eliminates.
